annotations.title: Provides information about Incidents in the cluster

description:
List the current firing incidents in the cluster. 
		One incident is a group of related alerts that are likely triggered by the same root cause.
		Use this tool to analyze the cluster health status and determine why a component is failing or degraded.

min_severity.description: Minimum severity level to be applied as filter for incidents. Allowed values, from lower severity to higher severity, can be: info, warning and critical. Default: warning.

time_range.description: Maximum age of incidents to include in hours (max 360 for 15 days). Default: 360

name: get_incidents
title: Provides information about Incidents in the cluster
